_what_this_is: The deliberate defects the gate is measured against. Each entry: one textual mutation applied to real source in a throwaway copy; the gate MUST go red. An escaped defect is a class of bug that can currently merge unreviewed. NOT_INJECTED (anchor moved) is a failure too - a defect that tests nothing reports as a perfect score for doing nothing.

defects.why: the interview's fear: correct answer always position 0 - kids learn to tap the slot, not the letter. Must be caught by the unit distribution test AND holdout S3.

defects.replace: void state; // mutated: the save never happens
defects.why: everything works until the browser closes, then all progress is gone. Must be caught by the restart unit test AND the E2E reload step.

the app actively teaches a wrong letter-word mapping to a child. Must be caught by content validation AND holdout S4.

teaching content in the wrong language on an Arabic-UI screen. Must be caught by content validation AND holdout S4.
